note: Every quotation is OLCB (lug_bib) copied by script; rows are measured per block. 1 Maccabees 2:27 is not in OLCB and is self-rendered (not recorded as a canonical reference).

Where OLCB differs from the NIV the author argues from, the verse is kept and the surrounding sentence carries the point: Genesis 3:6 (no ‘who was with her’), 1 Timothy 2:8 (‘abantu’, glossed as men in the Greek), 1 Peter 3:7, Ephesians 6:4, Acts 20:34, Deuteronomy 6:7 (‘impress’), Proverbs 29:18 (the ‘older translation’ is self-rendered; the newer is OLCB).

English defects kept or worked around: the epigraph citation is fused into the first paragraph of every chapter (kept, the markup must match); 1 Samuel 18:14 is introduced as about Jonathan, but the verse is about David, so the lead-in names Dawudi.
AI-translated (job #2794) by fan-out over 4 translators; tag sequence identical to the English per chapter; awaiting native review.
